floater.name: plus_local_mesh
floater.title: LOCAL MESH
floater.string: Click an object in the world to select it. A mesh is shown on the selected object.
The selected object is not a mesh object. A local mesh can only be shown on one (rez any mesh you own to use as a stand-in).
The selected object is a rigged mesh. Rigged meshes are not supported yet.
The selected object's own mesh has not loaded yet. Wait a moment.
Mesh files on this PC (.dae, .gltf, .glb). Only you see them; nothing is uploaded.
The LODs read from files, highest to lowest (3 2 1 0). A missing one shows the next better one. Lower LODs are files beside it named like name_LOD2.dae, name_LOD1.dae, name_LOD0.dae.
Objects showing a mesh of the file
Read the selected file again (after you export it again); the objects showing it get the new version
Remove the selected file from the list; the objects showing it get their own mesh back
Read a file again by itself when you export it again (checked once a second)
The mesh of the file to show (a file can have several)
Give the object the size of the file
Off: the mesh is stretched to the object's own size. On: the object takes the size the file has, in meters (only in your viewer; not for attachments).
Show the mesh on the selected object, in your viewer only. While it shows a local mesh, the object does not take changes from the region.
Give the selected object its own mesh back
RmlUi is not used in safe mode.
The page could not be loaded (the log says why). Turning off the setting PlusRmlUiWindows and restarting brings back the old window.
